name: Transfix

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-2-spells.  Reference entry; bespoke effects require manual resolution. Artificer is omitted where listed because that class is not available in this game.

summary: Reference-only: A visible creature within 60 feet saves Charisma or becomes Charmed and Incapacitated, moving directly toward you on its turns. Ending a turn within 5 feet deals 4d8 Psychic. It provokes Opportunity Attacks normally and repeats the save before entering damaging terrain. Later Magic actions target more creatures; one that saved against this casting cannot be retargeted. Add 1d8 damage per slot above 7.
